status: host-reference-only; runtime and compiler parity not established
chunk_semantics: each chunk is one complete compressed access unit, or a bounded independently replayable encoded segment explicitly admitted by codec provider
counters: u64 on native backends; JS reference admits nonnegative safe integers only; sequence initial 0, last-applied sentinel -1
acknowledgment: cumulative highest contiguous fully applied sequence + matching end byte offset; never treat network receipt alone as applied

resume_modes.continue: no missing chunks and byte offset matches
resume_modes.replay: all missing retained chunks contiguous and decoder configuration matches
resume_modes.reset: missing chunks or config mismatch; restart from retained verified random-access point after decoder reset
resume_modes.fail: KEYFRAME_REQUIRED when no safe retained decoder anchor exists

security_notes: Transport authentication, anti-replay, resource capability and integrity verification are mandatory at host ingress and not implemented by the host state-machine reference.
The randomAccess flag must be derived from trusted codec parsing and a complete independently decodable restart point, never accepted from untrusted transport metadata.
A per-stream payload limit does not bound object headers, crypto engine temporary allocations or whole-process RSS. Admission must include global and per-tenant memory limits.
